info.title: PudimFinance API
info.description: Personal finance application API. Immutable double-entry ledger, event sourcing, real-time reporting, receipt scanning and price tracking.

post.summary: Logs a user in and returns tokens.

get.summary: Returns current user info from Bearer token.
Lists budgets for a given month/year, joined with category display info.

200.description: List of budgets for the period

post.summary: Creates or updates a budget (upsert on (category_id, month, year)).

get.summary: Returns budget vs actual spending for a given month/year.
Lists categories, optionally filtered by type.
get.description: Returns `400` if an invalid `type` filter is provided.

post.description:
Returns `400` if the payload is invalid (missing name, invalid type,
non-existent parent category).

get.summary: Lists all accounts in the chart of accounts.
Lists ledger transactions (grouped by transaction_id) with their entries.

post.summary: Creates a new double-entry ledger transaction.
Migrates all simple transactions to double-entry ledger pairs.
Reconciles uploaded statement lines against existing transactions.

get.summary: Category spending breakdown for a date range.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date (ISO). Default: first day of current month

get.summary: Monthly income/expense summary over a date range.
Monthly trends (income, expense, net) over the last N months.

Returns income, expense, and balance totals for a given month,
with a per-category breakdown.
Lists transactions, with optional filters (category, type, date range) and pagination.
Returns a single transaction by ID.

Returns the health status of the backend and its dependencies
(PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ). Returns 200 if healthy, 503 if degraded.

Exposes Prometheus-formatted metrics for scraping.
This endpoint is served on a separate port in production (default 3001).

Budget.description: A monthly budget limit for a category.

amount_limit.description: Maximum spend limit for the month.

BudgetListResponse.description: Response for a paginated/period budget list.

BudgetSummaryItem.description: Budget vs actual spending for a single budget.

actual_spent.description: Actual spending for the category in the month (from transactions).

percentage.description: Percentage of the limit used (0-100+, can exceed 100).

remaining.description: Remaining amount = condition. negative => over budget.

BudgetSummaryResponse.description: Response for the budget summary endpoint.

total_budgeted.description: Sum of all budget limits for the period.

total_spent.description: Sum of all actual spending for budgeted categories.

BudgetWithCategory.description: Budget joined with its category display info.

amount_limit.description: Maximum spend limit for the month.

category_id.description: Category id this budget applies to.

Category.description: A transaction category (income or expense), optionally nested via `parent_id`.

icon.description: Icon identifier used by the web/mobile UIs.

CategoryBreakdownItem.description: A single category's aggregated totals for the category-breakdown report.

percentage.description: Percentage of all expenses for the period.

transaction_count.description: Number of transactions in this category.

categories.description: Per-category totals, sorted by total descending.

CategoryListParams.description: Query parameters for filtering the category list.

CategorySummary.description: Per-category totals for the summary endpoint.

category_id.description: Category UUID (null for transactions without a category).

color.description: Hex color code for the category.

CreateBudgetRequest.description: Payload for creating or updating a budget (upsert).

category_id.description: Category this budget applies to (expense categories only).

CreateCategoryRequest.description: Payload for creating a new category.

icon.description: Icon identifier used by the web/mobile UIs.

CreateLedgerTransactionRequest.description: Payload for creating a ledger transaction (double-entry).

entries.description: At least two entries; debits must equal credits.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (unique per client request).

CreateLedgerTransactionResponse.description: Response for creating a ledger transaction.

status.description: HTTP status to return (201 or 200 for idempotent replay).

CreateTransactionRequest.description: Payload for creating a new transaction.

HealthError.description: Failed health check payload returned with HTTP 503.

HealthResponse.description: Successful health check payload returned with HTTP 200.

account_id.description: Account ID this entry posts to.

account_name.description: Account display name (nullable, populated on list queries).

transaction_id.description: Transaction ID this entry belongs to.

LedgerEntryRequest.description: A single debit/credit entry in a ledger transaction.

credit_amount.description: Credit amount (positive; must be zero on debit entries).

debit_amount.description: Debit amount (positive; must be zero on credit entries).

LedgerTransaction.description: A full ledger transaction with its entries.

entries.description: All ledger entries (must balance: debits = credits).

transaction_id.description: Unique transaction ID linking all entries.

MonthlyReportItem.description: A single month's income/expense totals for the monthly report.

months.description: One entry per month in the requested range (chronological order).

ReconciliationItem.description: A reconciliation item result (matched or unmatched).

matched_transaction_id.description: Transaction ID if matched, otherwise NULL.

reconciliation_id.description: Reconciliation ID this item belongs to.

ReconciliationUploadRequest.description: Payload containing all CSV statement lines for reconciliation.

lines.description: Statement lines parsed from the uploaded CSV.

unmatched_rows.description: Rows that don't match any existing transaction.

RefreshRequest.description: Request body for refreshing an access token.

RegisterRequest.description: Request body for registering a new user.

StatementLine.description: A single line item from an uploaded bank statement.

amount.description: Signed amount (negative for expense/debit, positive for income/credit).

SummaryParams.description: Query parameters for the summary endpoint.

month.description: Month to summarise, 1-12 (defaults to current month).

year.description: Year to summarise (defaults to current year).

SummaryResponse.description: Monthly summary response: income, expense, balance, and category breakdown.

expense_total.description: Total expenses for the selected month (positive value).

income_total.description: Total income for the selected month (positive value).

Transaction.description: A single income or expense transaction.

amount.description: Monetary amount — always positive; `type` determines direction.

category_id.description: Category this transaction belongs to (nullable if category deleted).

page_size.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 50, max 200).

TransactionListResponse.description: Response wrapper for paginated transaction lists.

page_size.description: Page size used for this request.

total.description: Total row count matching the filters (regardless of pagination).

TrendPoint.description: A single point in the trends report.

UpdateTransactionRequest.description: Payload for updating an existing transaction.
